title: Spices That Heal Us
subject: English
summary: “Spices That Heal Us” is a chapter about the importance and medicinal uses of spices in our daily lives. It explains how spices like turmeric, ginger, pepper, cloves, cinnamon and cardamom are useful for our health. These spices are not only used to make food tasty but also help in treating common health problems. Turmeric helps heal wounds, ginger is useful for cough and cold, and pepper helps with digestion. Our traditional spices have been used as natural remedies for many years. The chapter teaches us that spices are valuable gifts of nature that make our food tasty and help us stay healthy.
